about:
Grand Rapids Controls Co., LLC was founded in 1968 in Rockford, Michigan. The company began as a motion-control mechanical cable specialist and has since expanded into a global provider of electromechanical cables, handles, and actuators.

The company designs and manufactures cable and actuator systems using a vertically integrated process that includes extrusion, die casting, insert and over molding, two-shot molding, swaging, stamping, automated assembly, and a range of welding and decorating operations. Engineering services cover 3D CAD design, stress and mold-flow analysis, DVP&R, DFMEA, APQP, and environmental, acoustic, and longevity testing. Production spans facilities in Rockford, Michigan; Qingdao, China; and Oradea, Romania.

Grand Rapids Controls serves the automotive, aerospace, defense, office, and commercial/industrial sectors. Its portfolio includes industry-first innovations such as power sliding van door cable systems, anti-theft side door cables, lumbar cables for automotive seating, cable-driven adjustable back height controls for office chairs, and stored-energy single-handle seat controls. The company also supplies kinetic energy systems, handle assemblies, flexshafts, seat control modules, and latch-release systems.

Founded on a problem-solving ethos, the company emphasizes collaborative engineering and a holistic methodology that links design through production. It positions itself as a worry-free partner that delivers intuitive motion solutions through global footprint, vertical integration, and a track record of industry-first products.
